create_base_tracker_predictor: create a BaseTrackerPredictor instance with configurable stride, correlation levels, radius, and transformer depth
run_forward_tracking: run the forward pass of BaseTrackerPredictor to predict 2D track coordinates across video frames given query points and feature maps
build_corr_block: build a CorrBlock for computing correlation volumes between track features and image feature maps
predict_visibility: predict visibility scores for tracked points across frames using the vis_predictor layer
update_track_features: update track feature representations iteratively using the EfficientUpdateFormer and ffeat_updater module
